product_overview: Sellora Backend is a FastAPI-based backend that supports authenticated access, analysis workflows, and competitor tracking capabilities. It provides API services backed by Python, Supabase, and Gemini for core product operations.
core_goals: Provide secure authentication for API consumers
Enable analysis operations through backend endpoints
Support competitor tracking functionality for product intelligence
Deliver a scalable FastAPI service layer backed by Supabase and Gemini

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Allows users to authenticate and access protected backend resources.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> Use token to access protected endpoints -> Receive 200 with authorized response
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> User remains unauthenticated

features.name: Analysis API
features.description: Provides endpoints for submitting or retrieving analysis results from the backend.
user_flows: POST /api/analysis with valid analysis payload -> Receive 200 with analysis result -> GET /api/analysis/{id} with returned identifier -> Receive 200 with stored analysis details
POST /api/analysis with malformed or incomplete payload -> Receive 422 validation error -> Analysis is not created

features.name: Competitor Tracking API
features.description: Enables users to create and manage competitor tracking records and retrieve competitor insights.
user_flows: POST /api/competitors/tracking with competitor details -> Receive 201 with tracking record -> GET /api/competitors/tracking/{id} -> Receive 200 with tracked competitor data
POST /api/competitors/tracking with missing competitor information -> Receive 422 validation error -> No tracking record is created
